breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

It presents with mild to moderately severe, slowly progressive usual clinical features of Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease (muscle weakness and atrophy of the distal extremities, distal sensory loss, reduced or absent deep tendon reflexes, and feet deformities). Other findings include asymptomatic neutropenia and early-onset cataracts.

master.definition_en: A rare but serious cerebrovascular disorder involving thrombosis of the cerebral venous system. It affects children from the newborn period through childhood and adolescence. In childhood CSVT, acute infections of the head and neck such as mastoiditis are most common, followed by chronic underlying diseases such as nephrotic syndrome, cancer, and inflammatory bowel disease. Signs and symptoms are also age related. Seizures and altered mental status are the commonest manifestations in newborns. Headache, vomiting, and lethargy, sometimes with 6th nerve palsy, are the most common symptoms in children and adolescents.

curated.category: 罕见急性致死性血管性水肿
curated.lethality_detail_zh: SERPING1突变导致血浆C1酯酶抑制物(C1-INH)缺乏或功能障碍，激肽释放酶-缓激肽过度激活引发局部皮下与黏膜深层水肿；因属于缓激肽而非组胺介导，肾上腺素/抗组胺/糖皮质激素完全无效！当发生致命性急性喉头水肿时，可于数十分钟至数小时内机械性窒息死亡；文献显示未获规范急救下喉水肿历史病死率高达30%–34%。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 中国已形成“急性按需急救(艾替班特)+长期预防(拉那利尤单抗)”双核心国家常规药品保障准入闭环，可近乎完全消除致命性喉头水肿及剧烈腹痛发作；但基层急诊因误作过敏仅给抗组胺/激素耽误插管仍是致命风险点。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO与GBD未单列HAE全球年死亡总数；临床统计未获特异性药物救治的喉头水肿患者历史病死率达30%–34%（PMC7846295）
annual_deaths_global.source: HAE Laryngeal Edema Mortality Study (PMC7846295) / Orphanet ORPHA:91378

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国无单列官方年死亡数；因高误诊率及基层缺备艾替班特，急性喉头水肿误当过敏抢救无效致窒息曾是主要死因
annual_deaths_china.source: China HAE Cohort Study (PMC12325137) / 国家《第一批罕见病目录》

epidemiology.prevalence_global: Orphanet欧洲点患病率约5.0/10万（临床常规估算约1/50,000，ORPHA:91378）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国大湾区多中心等研究报道确诊患病率约0.04–0.6/10万（98%属I型，全国实际登记确诊数百至千余例，按1/5万推算潜在患者约1.5万–3万例，PMC12325137）；纳入国家《第一批罕见病目录》

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: HAE急性喉头水肿/声音嘶哑吞咽困难超级急症抢救：(1) 高度警惕：传统过敏三联药物（肾上腺素、糖皮质激素、苯海拉明/氯雷他定）对HAE无效，严禁因等待激素起效而延误气道处理！；(2) 即刻随身/急诊皮下注射缓激肽B2受体拮抗剂醋酸艾替班特(30 mg sc)或静脉输注人C1-INH浓缩制剂(若缺乏特异性药且危及生命时可应急输注新鲜冰冻血浆FFP以补充C1-INH)；(3) 声音变化、吸气性喉鸣或咽后壁水肿即刻启动耳鼻喉及麻醉科清醒纤维支气管镜下气管插管，水肿完全梗阻插管失败时果断行环甲膜切开或紧急气管切开。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 全球首个HAE体内CRISPR-Cas9基因编辑疗法NTLA-2002(靶向肝脏KLKB1永久下调激肽释放酶)已步入Phase 3临床试验，单次静脉输注即实现超90%患者多年零发作的功能性治愈潜力；新一代抗XIIa因子单抗Garadacimab(每月一次皮下)与全球首个按需口服激肽释放酶抑制剂Sebetralstat(告别急性期随身针剂)正在海外获批或注册递交中。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 国内90%以上潜在患者仍长期被误诊为慢性过敏性喉炎或急腹症（曾致不必要剖腹探查及窒息悲剧）；拉那利尤单抗需持续高频注射且自付部分对低收入家庭仍有一定压力，临床急需引入口服按需药物及一次性基因编辑治愈疗法。

master.definition_en: Renal hypodysplasia/aplasia 3 (RHDA3) is an autosomal dominant disorder characterized by abnormal kidney development beginning in utero. The phenotype is highly variable, even within families, and there is evidence for incomplete penetrance. Some affected individuals have bilateral renal agenesis, which is usually fatal in utero or in the perinatal period, whereas others may have unilateral agenesis that is compatible with life, or milder manifestations, such as vesicoureteral reflux (VUR). Female mutation carriers may also have uterine or ovarian abnormalities. Renal aplasia falls at the most severe end of the spectrum of congenital anomalies of the kidney and urinary tract (CAKUT; see 610805) (summary by Brophy et al., 2017 and Sanna-Cherchi et al., 2017).

Bilateral thalamic hypometabolism on FDG-PET imaging and positive prion seeding activity in the cerebrospinal fluid are present in many cases. The disease is fatal within typically two to three years.

master.definition_en: A rare autoinflammatory syndrome characterized by mostly early-onset, recurrent, refractory fever attacks, painful and recurrent mucosal ulceration affecting predominantly gastrointestinal (that may lead to inflammatory bowel disease), oral and genital areas. Additional variable features may include skin rash, psoriasis, axillary dermal abscesses, musculoskeletal disorders, polyarthritis, arthralgia, and autoimmune thyroid disorder. Ocular manifestations (including uveitis, chorioretinal scarring and macular fibrosis secondary to retinal vasculitis) are infrequent.

master.definition_en: A rare skin disease characterized by non-infectious eosinophilic infiltration of the hair follicles. Patients present with chronically recurrent crops of itchy follicular papulopustules with peripheral extension and central clearing. Small papules tend to enlarge and coalesce into large plaques. The lesions favor the face and trunk, although the extremities can also be involved. Laboratory analysis may show peripheral leukocytosis and eosinophilia, while, clinically, systemic involvement is not evident.
